eras.name: The Yellow Turbans
eras.summary: The Yellow Turbans rise across the empire; Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei swear brotherhood and win their first battles.
eras.summary_zh: 黄巾起义席卷天下，刘关张桃园结义，初立战功。

snapshots.label: The Eastern Han's thirteen provinces
snapshots.label_zh: 东汉十三州

eras.name: Dong Zhuo
eras.summary: Dong Zhuo seizes the court, the eastern lords rise against him, he burns Luoyang and moves the court west, and Lü Bu kills him.
eras.summary_zh: 董卓入京废立，关东诸侯起兵讨伐，董卓火烧洛阳挟帝西迁，终为吕布所杀。

snapshots.label: The Eastern Han's thirteen provinces
snapshots.label_zh: 东汉十三州

snapshots.label: 191: Dong Zhuo moves the court to Chang'an; governors hold their provinces
snapshots.label_zh: 191年：董卓挟天子西迁长安，州郡长官各据一方

eras.name: The Warlords
eras.summary: Cao Cao, Lü Bu, Yuan Shu, Sun Ce and Liu Bei fight for the middle of the empire; Cao Cao takes the emperor to Xu.
eras.summary_zh: 曹操、吕布、袁术、孙策、刘备逐鹿中原，曹操迎献帝都许，挟天子以令诸侯。

snapshots.label: 191: Dong Zhuo moves the court to Chang'an; governors hold their provinces
snapshots.label_zh: 191年：董卓挟天子西迁长安，州郡长官各据一方

snapshots.label: 194: Cao Cao holds Yan, Liu Bei is given Xu, Li Jue and Guo Si hold the court
snapshots.label_zh: 194年：曹操据兖州，刘备领徐州，李傕、郭汜把持朝廷

snapshots.label: 196: Lü Bu takes Xu, Cao Cao brings the emperor to Xu, Sun Ce takes the lower Yangzi
snapshots.label_zh: 196年：吕布夺徐州，曹操迎献帝都许，孙策平定江东

snapshots.label: 199: on the eve of Guandu, Yuan Shao holds the north, Cao Cao the middle
snapshots.label_zh: 199年：官渡之战前夕，袁绍据河北四州，曹操据中原

eras.name: Guandu and the North
eras.summary: Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao at Guandu and unites the north; Guan Yu crosses five passes; Liu Bei visits Zhuge Liang three times.
eras.summary_zh: 官渡之战曹操大破袁绍，统一北方；关羽过五关斩六将；刘备三顾茅庐。

snapshots.label: 199: on the eve of Guandu, Yuan Shao holds the north, Cao Cao the middle
snapshots.label_zh: 199年：官渡之战前夕，袁绍据河北四州，曹操据中原

snapshots.label: 204: Yuan Shao is dead; Cao Cao takes Ye, Ji and Qing
snapshots.label_zh: 204年：袁绍已死，曹操攻克邺城，取冀州、青州

snapshots.label: 207: Cao Cao has united the north
snapshots.label_zh: 207年：曹操统一北方

eras.name: The Red Cliffs
eras.summary: Cao Cao comes south, Liu Bei flees at Changban, Sun and Liu ally and burn his fleet at the Red Cliffs; Zhou Yu dies.
eras.summary_zh: 曹操南下，长坂坡刘备败走，孙刘联军火烧赤壁，周瑜病逝。

snapshots.label: 207: Cao Cao has united the north
snapshots.label_zh: 207年：曹操统一北方

snapshots.label: 209: after the Red Cliffs, Liu Bei takes the four commanderies south of the Yangzi
snapshots.label_zh: 209年：赤壁之后，刘备取荆南四郡，周瑜取江陵

eras.name: The Realm Divided in Three
eras.summary: Liu Bei takes Yizhou and Hanzhong; Cao Cao becomes King of Wei; Guan Yu floods seven armies and loses Jingzhou.
eras.summary_zh: 刘备取益州、汉中，曹操进位魏王，关羽水淹七军，大意失荆州。

snapshots.label: 211: Cao Cao wins Guanzhong at Tong Pass; Liu Bei borrows Jingzhou
snapshots.label_zh: 211年：曹操潼关破马超取关中，刘备借得荆州

snapshots.label: 214: Liu Bei takes Yizhou
snapshots.label_zh: 214年：刘备取益州

snapshots.label: 215: Jingzhou divided along the Xiang; Cao Cao takes Hanzhong
snapshots.label_zh: 215年：孙刘湘水划界，曹操取汉中

snapshots.label: 219: Liu Bei takes Hanzhong and calls himself its king
snapshots.label_zh: 219年：刘备取汉中，自立为汉中王

eras.name: Three Emperors
eras.summary: Cao Pi ends the Han, Liu Bei and later Sun Quan take the title; Liu Bei is burned out at Yiling and dies at Baidi.
eras.summary_zh: 曹丕代汉，刘备称帝，夷陵之战火烧连营，白帝城托孤。

snapshots.label: 220: Wu takes Jingzhou; Cao Pi ends the Han; Wei, Shu and Wu
snapshots.label_zh: 220年：孙权袭取荆州，曹丕代汉，三国鼎立

eras.name: Zhuge Liang's Campaigns
eras.summary: Zhuge Liang pacifies the south, then marches north six times; Jieting, the empty city, and the death at Wuzhang Plains.
eras.summary_zh: 诸葛亮南征七擒孟获，六出祁山北伐，失街亭、空城计，星落五丈原。

snapshots.label: 220: Wu takes Jingzhou; Cao Pi ends the Han; Wei, Shu and Wu
snapshots.label_zh: 220年：孙权袭取荆州，曹丕代汉，三国鼎立

snapshots.label: 229: Zhuge Liang takes Wudu and Yinping
snapshots.label_zh: 229年：诸葛亮取武都、阴平

eras.name: The Rise of the Sima
eras.summary: Sima Yi takes power in Wei; Jiang Wei fights on in Shu; Wei conquers Shu.
eras.summary_zh: 司马懿高平陵夺权，姜维九伐中原，魏灭蜀汉。

snapshots.label: 229: Zhuge Liang takes Wudu and Yinping
snapshots.label_zh: 229年：诸葛亮取武都、阴平

snapshots.label: 238: Sima Yi destroys the Gongsun of Liaodong
snapshots.label_zh: 238年：司马懿平辽东公孙渊

snapshots.label: 263: Wei conquers Shu
snapshots.label_zh: 263年：魏灭蜀

eras.name: All Under Jin
eras.summary: Sima Yan ends Wei and founds Jin; Jin conquers Wu, and the three kingdoms are one.
eras.summary_zh: 司马炎代魏建晋，晋灭吴，三分归一统。

snapshots.label: 263: Wei conquers Shu
snapshots.label_zh: 263年：魏灭蜀

snapshots.label: 265: Sima Yan ends Wei and founds Jin
snapshots.label_zh: 265年：司马炎代魏建晋

snapshots.label: 280: Jin conquers Wu; the realm is one again
snapshots.label_zh: 280年：晋灭吴，三分归一统
